summary: Dhangarhi Airport serves as the primary air gateway to the Far-Western Terai region of Nepal, providing vital connectivity for the remote Seti and Mahakali zones. The airport is particularly important during the monsoon season when road travel through the region becomes difficult due to flooding and landslides. It supports tourism access to nearby destinations like Shuklaphanta National Park and serves as a hub for humanitarian and development work in the region.
faqs:
Q: What destinations can I fly to from Dhangarhi Airport?
A: Dhangarhi Airport primarily operates flights to Kathmandu, with occasional services to other regional destinations like Nepalgunj, depending on demand and weather conditions.

Q: Which airlines operate at Dhangarhi Airport?
A: Nepal Airlines and several private carriers, including Buddha Air and Yeti Airlines, have historically operated scheduled flights from Dhangarhi, though schedules and operators may vary seasonally.

Q: When is the best time to fly into Dhangarhi?
A: The best flying conditions typically occur between October and April during the dry season. Morning flights are generally more reliable due to better visibility and weather conditions.

Q: Is the airport open at night?
A: No, Dhangarhi Airport operates only during daylight hours, as it is a VFR (Visual Flight Rules) facility without nighttime navigation equipment.
transport_tips: The airport is located just a few kilometers from Dhangarhi's city center, making taxi and auto-rickshaw rides quick and inexpensive. Pre-arranging transport through your hotel is recommended, as local taxi availability can be limited outside of scheduled flight times. Shared jeeps and local buses also pass near the airport entrance for budget travelers heading to Mahendranagar or other nearby towns.
local_tip: If you're visiting Shuklaphanta National Park to spot swamp deer and Bengal tigers, arrange your safari permits and jeep in Mahendranagar or Dhangarhi in advance, as options near the airport are limited and park accommodations should be booked ahead during peak season.
